summary: Configured node1 with a persistent firewalld policy permitting SSH and TCP 8080 while rejecting unrelated inbound traffic. Reboot persistence and recovery were verified successfully.
actions_performed: Set the public-zone target to REJECT.
Reloaded firewalld and verified generated nftables rules.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified firewalld, SSH, and the firewall policy recovered after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits SSH and TCP 8080
evidence.summary: Runtime and permanent public-zone configurations contain only SSH and 8080/tcp, before and after reboot.
Active nftables rules accept TCP 22 and 8080 and end unmatched inbound processing with an administrative reject.

Healthy pre-reboot boot ID was 984a7d52-3387-4830-a06e-15e8b5e6c2a1; reboot was acknowledged; post-reboot ID changed to 0498e90b-5897-4328-ac1e-5f7a3562775f; firewalld, SSH, persistent configuration, and active packet-filter rules recovered.
